title: Correct pitched note-display scope and protect percussion ownership
scope: Make the capability database and pinned upstream inventory agree that arbitrary pitched note visibility and NoteStyle overrides are other-format/rendering fields, while percussion articulation notehead metadata remains in scope and separately owned.
acceptance: Change only the pitched note-display capability to explicit excluded/out-of-scope import, model and export, with exact source-assignment evidence. Retain a documented reopening criterion: a GP3–GP8 fixture, exact source field and independent retaining consumer for a pitched override.

Reconcile Note.isVisible, Note.style, NoteStyle.noteHead and NoteStyle.noteHeadCenterOnStem dispositions. The first two are already out-of-scope in the canonical upstream inventory; the two NoteStyle members currently remain partial and need the same evidence-backed disposition. Preserve each named symbol obligation rather than deleting inventory rows.

Add a focused inventory regression for the exact recorded GP scope, out-of-scope dispositions and source references resolving to the pinned revision. Retain GPIF articulation notehead assignments under percussion, with unchanged owner and symbol identities. Reuse existing ownership/percussion assertions where they already enforce the condition; source drift is enforced by the existing pin/hash checks, not a grep snapshot or an automated judgment about future evidence.

Regenerate SQLite and verify that pitched note-display is excluded from the Guitar Pro gap denominator while percussion ratings/claims and the canonical upstream symbol count remain unchanged. Run the inventory/ownership checks plus existing percussion notehead tests.
exclusions: No new public note-style API, invented GPIF properties, use of percussion identities for pitched styles, MusicXML/AlphaTex import, or rendering behavior.

reproduction.instructions: Compare catalog note-display (scope=guitar-pro; all stages missing) with canonical Note.isVisible/Note.style (out-of-scope), NoteStyle.noteHead/noteHeadCenterOnStem (partial). Inspect exact assignments in MusicXmlImporter, AlphaTex1LanguageHandler and Note.finish; GPIF notehead assignments belong to percussion articulations. Existing targeted command: ALPHATAB_CONFORMANCE=1 go test -count=1 -run '^(TestConformanceNoteheadOptions|TestGPIFPitchedTrackHasNoPercussionDefinitions|TestAlphaTabPreservesNativePercussionFallbacks)$' .

evidence.detail: out-of-scope: Pitched visibility/custom noteheads belong to other-format or rendering paths; percussion noteheads are separately modeled.

Record the actual assignments for pitched Note.isVisible and custom pitched NoteStyle fields, separating MusicXML/AlphaTex/rendering from Guitar Pro import paths. Give pitched visibility/noteheads an explicit scope disposition while retaining the separate percussion articulation notehead contract and tests. Resolve after the assignment evidence and database scope are reviewed. Reopen only with a non-default GP fixture and retaining consumer; do not reuse percussion IDs to simulate pitched styles.
Capability remains incorrectly counted as a Guitar Pro missing feature.
Note.isVisible is already out-of-scope; Note.style likewise at 2294; NoteStyle fields remain partial at 2420/2427.
Sets note.isVisible; custom notehead and centering assignments occur at 2841, 2853, 2876, 3023 and 3931–3958.
SongBook let-ring tie finalization derives invisible notes; this is not an authored GP visibility field.
GPIF Noteheads tokens populate articulation.noteHeadDefault/Half/Whole; they are not pitched NoteStyle assignments.
Passed with ALPHATAB_CONFORMANCE=1 at reviewed commit. No new percussion behavior implementation is required.

This is inventory/conformance implementation, not feature implementation. Apply the narrow scope correction and enforce ownership. Do not close merely from the earlier out-of-scope comment while catalog and inventory still disagree.

resolution: Implemented the exact outside-Guitar-Pro scope, stage dispositions and pinned model exclusions. Focused inventory regressions pass. Awaiting independent review before solved status.
